local Characters = {}

function Characters:Start(Context)
	local Packages = Context.Packages
	local Services = Context.Services

	local Icon = Packages.Icon
	local CharacterService = Services.CharacterService

	-- Parent icon — top-level "Characters" dropdown
	local CharactersIcon = Icon.new()
	CharactersIcon:setLabel("Characters")
	CharactersIcon:setDropdown()
	
	-- GetMovesets() returns an array of { Name, Folder, Config, Moveset }
	-- Moveset is a flat array of { Name, Class, Icon, Module }
	for _, Char in CharacterService.GetMovesets() do
		local CharIcon = Icon.new()
		CharIcon:setLabel(Char.Name)

		-- Give each character its own sub-dropdown for moves
		CharIcon:setDropdown()

		-- Add every move as a disabled icon nested under this character
		for _, Move in Char.Moveset do
			local MoveIcon = Icon.new()
			MoveIcon:setLabel(Move.Name)
			if Move.Icon then
				MoveIcon:setImage(Move.Icon)
			end
			MoveIcon:setEnabled(false)
			MoveIcon:joinDropdown(CharIcon)
		end

		-- Nest the character icon under the top-level Characters dropdown
		CharIcon:joinDropdown(CharactersIcon)
	end

	return CharactersIcon
end

return Characters
